findings.subject: Actual curve, cofactor, nonidentity and scalar admission
findings.evidence: private_authorization.circom17-34,44-47: PA/PR and each doubled input/output are BabyCheck constrained; three stock BabyDbl stages bind actual xout/yout to A/R8. IsZero.out=0 guards both 1+168696*(x*y)^2 and 1-168696*(x*y)^2 on the same stage inputs. Target x!=0 follows image admission. Stock enabled=1 and unchanged Num2Bits253/CompConstant(Q-1) preserve 0<=S<Q. This uses standard #E=8Q/primeQ and existing stock-verifier arithmetic assumptions; no fresh point-count or formal completeness proof.

findings.subject: Canonical coordinates and exact two-limb prehash
findings.evidence: private_authorization.circom9-15,37-47: each AK byte has8-bit decomposition, both high coordinate bits are zero, Bits2Num_strict enforces canonical

findings.subject: Owner-local secret and degenerate result export boundary
findings.evidence: owner_signer.mjs6-19: A and R8 are on-curve, in-subgroup and x!=0 before return; S is a bigint in[0,Q). Seed remains local; no expanded scalar/prefix/nonce is exported or logged. Returned object is only schema,key,R8,S,statementSha256,packetSha256. The code uses unchanged stock prv2pub/signPoseidon; it does not alter deterministic nonce generation. This is source-level non-export evidence, not runtime isolation, memory-erasure or side-channel qualification.

findings.subject: Exact locked stock host representation
findings.evidence: EXISTING-JS-LOCK-01 selects circomlibjs0.1.7. Its admitted eddsa.js d0e393 uses blake-hash, not the newer noble capture. ESM package exports buildEddsa and buildPoseidon. Poseidon accepts BigInt-array inputs by F.e; owner converts result via poseidon.F.toObject and eddsa.F.e before signPoseidon, matching the locked signPoseidon field-element message API. Actual0.1.7 host/R1CS numeric parity still requires the held execution gate.

findings.subject: Verifier witness has no signing authority parameter
findings.evidence: verifier_aux.mjs7-17: strict authorization key names, exact lowercase AK64 hex and coordinate<P, canonical decimal R8/S<FIELD_P. It reconstructs packet limbs and returns only those limbs, key bytes, R8/S, cofactor preimages. Default preimages are INV8 times known points, with no discrete-log or signing-key input. Explicit arbitrary preimages remain available for circuit negative controls. Old metadata never overrides the rebuilt message. S<Q is intentionally deferred to R1CS so canonical-field S+Q can test its residual.

findings.subject: Public effects reconstruction and acceptance separation
findings.evidence: public_packet.mjs15-36 explicitly performs structural reconstruction only. It parses fixed193+3884 packet layout and derives effects from prefix plus body0:3756, then the exact200-byte role/domain/root/NF/CV/effects statement. Whole output tuples include their opaque output-proof bytes. It does not evaluate indexed NF/CM successor paths, verify proofs, authenticate currentness or authorize a transaction. Preserve separate public transition validation before any such claim.

freeze_clarifications.detail: Align Spec02 handoff wording with selected actual API: ownerKeyHex is Ax32LE||Ay32LE lowercase hex, while R8 coordinates and S are canonical unsigned decimal strings. Spec01 lines60-61 describes32LE R8/S transport. No mathematical/API change is required, but do not claim an unimplemented32LE signature serializer.

Retain parser/auxiliary-generation refusals separately from R1CS residual failures. Default INV8 computation on malformed/off-curve hostile points may stop before a complete witness; explicitPreimages does not create a genuine assigned UNSAT result by itself.

Authenticate the exact resolved host package closure and actual runtime mount/import boundary; the preparation directory node_modules was empty at review. Never mount/load owner_signer in a verifier job. Full package0.1.7 import exposes stock signing APIs but no seed is a verifier parameter; this review does not certify the future runtime boundary.
